provenance_legend.DG: officially released dataset fact, such as label vocabulary
provenance_legend.DO: directly observed annotation/media relationship; descriptive, not normative
provenance_legend.RD: research-derived interpretation, not official author ground truth
provenance_legend.POL: project policy proposal, not yet human-approved
provenance_legend.HUMAN: decision must be made/validated by project owner or process owner
provenance_legend.SOURCE_GAP: available source does not define or certify the claimed mapping

invariants: TAS-S label recognition is not process compliance
PSR prerequisite graph is not automatically the TAS-S workflow
recover_ok prerequisites are not remove_ok prerequisites
STORE_* does not automatically prove a component was removed
all actions remain non-executable until human workflow validation

actions.observation_meaning: A TAS-S start/initialization label; the word ASSEMBLY alone does not prove physical assembly.
actions.workflow_role: Boundary/auxiliary is an INT proposal; required status HUMAN decision.
actions.evidence_requirement: No validated evidence rule; confidence alone is insufficient.
actions.certification_boundary: May represent a labeled start action only; does not certify procedure state.

actions.state_effect: Loosening/preparation candidate; does not alone certify component removed.
actions.workflow_role: State-changing candidate; exact role HUMAN decision.
actions.prerequisite_domain: No TAS-S prerequisite established; do not copy recover_ok prerequisites.
actions.evidence_requirement: No validated rule; visible unscrewing and final detachment may be distinct evidence.
actions.certification_boundary: Cannot infer removed state from label alone.

actions.observation_meaning: Store/move the handle to a location.
actions.state_effect: Location/storage only; no PSR storage state and no removal certification.
actions.workflow_role: Auxiliary/logistics is an RD/INT candidate; status HUMAN decision.
actions.evidence_requirement: No validated rule; storage location must be visibly established if relevant.
actions.certification_boundary: Does not establish the unscrewing or removal transition.

actions.observation_meaning: Coarse TAS-S remove action for the locking-lever assembly.
actions.component: locking-lever assembly; source-grounded examples relate screw_lever, spring, lever, washer
actions.state_effect: Direct PSR event correspondence was observed in an inspected execution; universal coarse-label state effect remains INT/RD and needs review.
actions.workflow_role: Candidate state-changing action; mandatory status HUMAN decision.
actions.prerequisite_domain: PSR remove graph is separate; no direct TAS-S workflow edge established.
actions.evidence_requirement: No validated rule; component interaction/state evidence must be human-specified.
actions.certification_boundary: Observed label may support an action prediction, not automatically certify every assembly component state.

actions.state_effect: Location/storage only; no direct PSR storage state.
actions.certification_boundary: Does not itself prove the assembly was removed.

actions.observation_meaning: Coarse TAS-S extract/remove action for the bearing-plate assembly.
actions.component: bearing_plate assembly; source-grounded examples relate bearing_plate and bearing screws
actions.state_effect: Direct PSR event correspondence was observed in an inspected execution; universal coarse-label state effect remains INT/RD and needs review.
actions.workflow_role: Candidate state-changing action; mandatory status HUMAN decision.
actions.prerequisite_domain: PSR remove and recover prerequisite nodes are distinct; do not transfer recover edges.
actions.evidence_requirement: No validated rule; required visible state evidence is a HUMAN decision.
actions.certification_boundary: Action label is not a universal component-state certification contract.

actions.state_effect: Location/storage only; no direct PSR storage state.
actions.certification_boundary: Does not itself certify bearing-plate removal.

actions.observation_meaning: Coarse TAS-S detach/remove action for the adapter plate and fastening elements.
actions.component: adapter_plate and associated fasteners in source-grounded examples
actions.state_effect: Direct PSR event correspondence was observed in an inspected execution; this is not a universal official TAS-S mapping.
actions.workflow_role: Candidate state-changing action; mandatory status HUMAN decision.
actions.prerequisite_domain: Official graph has distinct adapter_plate remove/recover states; recover prerequisites do not define remove prerequisites.
actions.evidence_requirement: No validated rule; HUMAN must define which visible state change certifies effect.
actions.certification_boundary: Predicted detach label does not automatically certify every fine component state.

actions.observation_meaning: Coarse TAS-S remove/extract action for the rotor assembly.
actions.component: rotor assembly; source-grounded examples relate drive_shaft, bevel_gear and M6_nut
actions.state_effect: Direct PSR event correspondence was observed in inspected executions; universal coarse-label state effect remains RD/INT and needs review.
actions.workflow_role: Candidate state-changing action; mandatory status HUMAN decision.
actions.prerequisite_domain: Do not infer workflow constraints from PSR recover prerequisites.
actions.evidence_requirement: No validated rule; HUMAN must define state certification evidence.
actions.certification_boundary: Prediction alone does not certify the whole assembly state.

actions.state_effect: Location/storage only; no direct PSR storage state.
actions.certification_boundary: Does not itself prove rotor removal.

actions.state_effect: Storage/location only. It is not the separate PSR `Remove gearbox_housing` transition.
actions.prerequisite_domain: No TAS-S gearbox-removal prerequisite can be encoded from this action alone.
actions.evidence_requirement: No validated bridge/evidence policy exists for certifying gearbox removed.
actions.certification_boundary: Cannot certify gearbox_housing=REMOVED. Candidate outcome may remain STATE_UNCERTAIN unless a separate reviewed source/event establishes removal.

actions.state_effect: Location/storage only; no direct PSR storage state.
actions.certification_boundary: Does not itself prove adapter-plate removal.

actions.state_effect: Possible reversal toward installed state; exact coarse-to-PSR component mapping is not defined by the inspected source.
actions.prerequisite_domain: No accepted reverse-transition rule; HUMAN decision.
actions.evidence_requirement: No validated rule; must establish whether installation and resulting state are visible.
actions.certification_boundary: Do not automatically reverse previously accepted state or classify as recovery.

actions.state_effect: Possible reversal toward attached state; exact coarse-to-PSR mapping is not defined by inspected source.
actions.prerequisite_domain: No accepted reverse-transition rule; HUMAN decision.
actions.certification_boundary: Do not automatically reverse state or infer a violation.

actions.observation_meaning: Retrieve/move the bearing-plate assembly back into the active work area.
actions.state_effect: Location/context change only; PSR does not define a retrieve location state.
actions.certification_boundary: Not automatically required or a recovery transition.

actions.observation_meaning: Retrieve/move the locking-lever assembly back into the active work area.
actions.state_effect: Location/context change only; PSR does not define a retrieve location state.
actions.certification_boundary: Not automatically required or a recovery transition.

actions.observation_meaning: Store/move a tool; the coarse label does not identify the tool.
actions.state_effect: Tool location only; tool is not among the scoped PSR component instances.
actions.evidence_requirement: No validated rule; exact tool identity is not encoded in label.
actions.certification_boundary: Cannot certify a component state or tool-specific compliance.
